user.title: Mold Guard Configuration
user.description: Configure smart ventilation and mold protection for a specific room based on absolute humidity.

data_description.room_name: Name of the room to monitor (e.g. Living Room, Bedroom).
data_description.humidity_sensor: Relative humidity sensor inside the room.
data_description.window_contact: Optional contact sensor to pause alerts while window is already open.
data_description.notify_service: Notification service target (e.g. notify.alle_handys or notify.mobile_app_iphone).
data_description.abs_humidity_threshold: Threshold in g/m³ to trigger ventilation warning. Recommended: 8.5 g/m³ for 18-20 °C room temperatures.
data_description.humidity_diff: How much drier the outdoor air must be compared to indoor air (in g/m³) before recommending ventilation.
